name: Peninsula Gardens Pre-Roll | Yellow Mermaid
description: Yellow Zushi x Bebesita by Pheno Addicts. A Z lovers dream. Very sweet floral Z nose that translates amazingly well to the smoke. Has a different back end than our plan Z and a wonderful high. Buds are mainly green and not the prettiest but she makes up for it with crazy good flavor.
